me.name: Aqsa Zamzami
me.tagline: Building reliable backend architectures and fast, tactile web and mobile interfaces.
bio: I am a software engineer based in Indonesia. I spend my time digging into how software works under the hood, from raw socket streaming and database internals up to fluid 60fps UI engineering.
I focus on building resilient backend services and clean, responsive user interfaces. I believe good engineering should be transparent, fast, and satisfying to use.

projects.title: PRIME
projects.desc: An industrial predictive maintenance monorepo designed to process real-time machine telemetry, forecast failure risks before breakdowns happen, and provide semantic search across technical documentation.
projects.context: Part of an industrial predictive maintenance monorepo. The central focus was building an intelligent AI diagnostic assistant capable of cross-referencing live machine telemetry with technical documentation.
projects.contribution: Engineered the RAG pipeline and interactive AI diagnostic chatbot. Indexed equipment service manuals and operating guides using Qdrant vector embeddings, built semantic search retrieval handlers, and integrated LLM responses so maintenance technicians can troubleshoot machine anomalies in real time.
projects.highlight: RAG Retrieval Pipeline and AI Diagnostic Chatbot with Qdrant

projects.title: Ardana
projects.desc: A financial administration and cooperative ledger platform handling member savings, loan disbursements, and automated interest installment calculations.
projects.context: A financial administration and cooperative ledger platform where data integrity is paramount. Financial systems cannot tolerate calculation discrepancies, so establishing bulletproof relational accounting logic was the primary objective.
projects.contribution: Designed the relational database schema in PostgreSQL with strict transactional consistency and ACID rollback safety. Engineered core backend services in Laravel 12 to handle member savings deposits, loan disbursement workflows, and automated interest installment calculations.
projects.highlight: PostgreSQL Relational Ledger and Laravel 12 Backend Architecture

projects.title: ShareThem
projects.desc: A lightweight mobile application for peer-to-peer file transfer over local Wi-Fi without requiring an internet connection or account setup.
projects.context: A mobile application created as a clean, ad-free alternative to bloated commercial file-sharing utilities, focusing on seamless local peer-to-peer data exchange.
projects.contribution: Designed and built the reactive mobile frontend in Flutter. Crafted the animated device discovery radar, responsive file selection workflows, and an interactive real-time bottom sheet that tracks transfer progress with fluid visual feedback.
projects.highlight: Interactive Mobile UI and Real-Time Transfer Bottom-Sheet in Flutter

projects.title: Expasign
projects.desc: An event and competition registration platform that automates ticket allocation and payment verification using Saweria webhook callbacks.
projects.context: An event registration and competition platform built to streamline ticket purchases and participant intake during a large-scale campus technology event.
projects.contribution: Developed the responsive web frontend using React and Tailwind CSS. Built dynamic multi-step registration forms for various competition categories, interactive pricing tiers, and real-time payment status indicator screens.
projects.highlight: Responsive Multi-Category Registration and Checkout Frontend in React

projects.title: InvenSync
projects.desc: A retail Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management web app powered by Oracle Database 21c.
projects.context: An enterprise retail Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management system designed around strict enterprise relational database standards.
projects.contribution: Modeled the enterprise relational database schema on Oracle Database 21c and implemented the custom PHP MVC backend. Wrote native PL/SQL triggers for automated inventory audits, sequences for receipt tracking, and backend controllers for multi-table cashier transactions.
projects.highlight: Oracle Database 21c PL/SQL Triggers and Custom PHP MVC Backend

projects.title: PickyNet
projects.desc: A decision support system that evaluates and ranks Internet Service Providers using the WASPAS multi-criteria mathematical model.
projects.context: An academic Decision Support System (SPK) designed to provide objective, mathematical recommendations for Internet Service Providers based on user-defined criteria.
projects.contribution: Implemented the core WASPAS mathematical decision engine in Laravel alongside the interactive user frontend. Programmed the matrix normalization (WSM) and exponential weighting (WPM) algorithms, and designed intuitive comparative result tables and ranking cards.
projects.highlight: WASPAS Mathematical Decision Engine and Comparative Frontend
